verdict.rationale: Khoj documents 'agents' only as custom personas with their own system prompts, knowledge, chat models and tools. Nothing in the evidence shows those agents cooperating, spawning subagents, forming swarms, or using an agent-to-agent protocol to split and parallelize work. Custom personas are an adjacent feature, not multi-agent orchestration, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can work together — subagents, swarms, or an agent-to-agent protocol that splits and parallelizes real work
